topic: How to Open a Brokerage Account
source_evidence: In selecting an objective/risk category, you should also consider when you expect to need fast access to the funds in your account.
question: Misconception: When opening a brokerage account, I can choose an investment objective and risk category based only on how much growth I want; when I might need the funds does not matter.
answer: Your expected timing for needing access to the funds is also a factor to consider when selecting an objective and risk category.
